def test_router():
    r = EndpointRouter()
    r.register("/health", lambda: "ok")
    assert r.resolve("/health")() == "ok"
    assert r.resolve("/missing") is None

def test_register_prefix():
    r = EndpointRouter()
    r.register_prefix("/api", lambda: "api")
    assert r.resolve("/api")() == "api"
    assert r.resolve("/api/users")() == "api"
    assert r.resolve("/api/v1/data")() == "api"
    assert r.resolve("/other") is None
